partition_a_incremental_refresh.rationale: Retain 100% of verified split-adjusted Alpaca SIP historical prefix; append missing recent tail sessions.

partition_b_standard_unprovenanced.rationale: Earliest stored dates range from 2025-08-27 to 2025-11-03. Window [2025-01-02, T_completed] completely envelopes existing unprovenanced bars, satisfying the adapter scope invariant without triggering outside-window errors.

partition_b_extended_unprovenanced_nvda.rationale: NVDA has unprovenanced history extending back to 2023-10-27 (769 bars). Derived replacement window must start at 2023-10-27 to prevent fail-closed INCOMPATIBLE_HISTORY_OUTSIDE_REVIEWED_SCOPE error.

derived_replacement_windows.adjustment_basis_consequences: Replacing unprovenanced bars with Alpaca Consolidated Tape SIP split-adjusted bars guarantees 100% uniform SPLIT_ADJUSTED_ONLY basis (dividends unadjusted) across all 500 symbols, eliminating mixed-adjustment anomalies in moving averages.

execution_budgets_and_deadlines.request_accounting_policy: Charge every transmission immediately before sending; retries charge to both cumulative retry ceiling and aggregate cap; exhaustion inside retry sequence halts execution

resume_contract.crash_between_commit_and_checkpoint_hand: Committed bars are durable; re-evaluation upon resume is idempotent and skips redundant writes

quiesced_recovery_procedure.step_1: Verify pre-refresh backup existence, non-zero size, and PRAGMA integrity_check (?mode=ro) BEFORE touching target
quiesced_recovery_procedure.step_2: Verify target quiescence via exclusive lock acquisition (BEGIN EXCLUSIVE) and PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE); fail closed on lock/checkpoint contention
quiesced_recovery_procedure.step_4: Byte-for-byte restore from backup via shutil.copy2
quiesced_recovery_procedure.step_5: Verify integrity with PRAGMA integrity_check (?mode=ro), clean ephemeral sidecars, and assert exact SHA-256 equality
